What if you could buy an app making $10,000 a month, pay almost none of your own cash, and profit from day one? Steve Young has been in the app space since 2010, and in this episode he pulls back the curtain on how he buys cash flowing apps like rental properties and turns undermonetized ones into cash machines, including one purchase that has made over a million dollars and did about 500,000 last year alone. He dismantles the myth that a better product wins and shows why distribution is the real moat. You will learn his exact ASO keyword system for finding niches nobody is fighting over, why he targets painkiller keywords with search volume around 30 and up, and how he found the keyword first then built the app to hit number one inside a week. 

He breaks down the loan structure that lets him buy a $350,000 app while profiting $5,000 a month on money that isn't his, plus the hard paywall move that took the trial start rate from 6% to 13% and doubled revenue with zero new downloads or features. You will also see how he reads title and subtitle optimization, when to run Meta at a $3 revenue per install floor, and how sending early Facebook pixel signals makes your ad account smarter. By the end you will know how to spot undermonetized apps, price them with a hard paywall, and stack keywords the way top founders do.
